lines.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer. Do you have the iPhone 17, 256 GB, in lavender?
Yes sir, one piece is there.
Great. What's the final price? Is there any card offer?
It's seventy-nine nine hundred. With ICICI card, four thousand off. So seventy-five nine hundred final.
Seventy-five thousand nine hundred with an ICICI card. Can you hold it for this evening?
Hold I can't promise, sir. Better to come early.
Understood. Thank you, I'll pass this on to the customer.
